Shai-Hulud npm Worm Campaign

Campaign: shai-hulud-npm-2025
Date: 2025-09-14 to 2025-09-16 (2 days)
Attribution: Third Party
Cause: Credential Compromise
Motive: Credential Theft
Impact Type: Credential theft, Self-Propagation

Synopsis

The September 2025 Shai-Hulud npm worm campaign compromised official npm packages and used install-time JavaScript to steal developer and cloud credentials, publish secrets into attacker-controlled GitHub repositories, and attempt self-propagation through stolen npm tokens. This campaign groups the first major Shai-Hulud package records while keeping individual projects readable as separate attacks.

CrowdStrike NPM Packages Compromise (Shai-Hulud Worm)
